collection.title: VW Passat Saloon 1988 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Passat Saloon 1988 to 1995 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
